notes:
✓ Fixed peso sale per product, alongside the existing % sale. The % comes
   off first, then the peso amount, floored at zero. The three add-to-cart
   paths now share one pricing function instead of three copies of it.
✓ The order discount TYPE reaches the cloud, so a ₱20 sale and a 20% sale
   on a ₱100 order stop arriving as an indistinguishable 20.
✓ QR / InstaPay is a tender of its own, split from GCash in every report and
   on the dashboard. The shop QR shows on screen until payment is confirmed.
✓ QR stays out of the expected-drawer figure, as GCash already did.
✓ Flavour and variant prompts: fries flavours (single), Trio Fries (up to 3),
   egg, extra rice, toasted bread, patty, sugar level and priced drink add-ons.
✓ One stock ceiling is shared across a product's flavour lines. Five in stock
   can no longer be sold as five BBQ plus five Cheese.
✓ Flavour seasonings deduct from Prep stock on the till and in the database,
   and a void reverses exactly what the sale took.
✓ Pancit Canton now asks its pack flavour — Calamansi, Extra Hot or
   Chilimansi — before the egg and toasted bread questions. No flavour is
   preselected, so a ticket cannot reach the kitchen without one.
✓ AUDIT FIX: add-on and Extra Rice upcharges were always charged correctly,
   but the receipt, the printed receipt, the CSV export, the history row, the
   post-sale summary and the dashboard all named the item without its
   variants — so a ₱125 latte billed at ₱205 printed as "Cafe Latte 205.00"
   with nothing to explain the extra ₱80. Every itemisation now names them.
✓ PRICING FIX: "With Egg" was free AND preselected, so every rice meal and
   Pancit Canton shipped a free egg without the cashier touching anything.
   With Egg now adds ₱30 to match the Extra Egg menu line, and the default is
   the base price so an egg is only ever added deliberately.
✓ Meals already named "with Egg" (Sisig, Spam, Tocino) now offer a SECOND egg
   at ₱30 — previously they were asked nothing and a second egg could not be
   rung on the line at all.
✓ "Sisig without Egg" is offered no egg option: the egg version is its own
   menu item at ₱140, so ₱125 + ₱30 would have overcharged.
✓ An egg added as a modifier now comes off the same Egg ingredient stock as
   one sold through the Extra Egg line.
✓ Extra Egg is now a ticked ADD-ON on every meal, ₱30, alongside Extra Rice
   — matching how it is listed under Add Ons rather than being asked as a
   with-or-without question.
✓ Extra Rice moved into that same add-on group. It previously had its own
   Regular/Extra picker, so once Extra Egg joined there would have been two
   routes to the same ₱30 and a line could be charged twice.
✓ Meals whose name already includes an egg (Sisig, Spam, Tocino, and Pancit
   if stored "w/ Egg") can now DECLINE that egg free of charge, and can still
   add a second one at ₱30.
✓ Only the add-on egg moves ingredient stock; the egg already in a product's
   price belongs to its recipe and is no longer double-counted.
